source_standard: AMEC Integrated Evaluation Framework (Barcelona Principles), https://amecorg.com/amecframework/

reference_resolution.rule: outcome must trace back to a stated objective on the same record — no orphan outcomes (AMEC's own chain requirement).

recomputation.rule: outcome is recomputed from the current channel's actual measured output, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a PR or communications activity concludes AND no pr-communications record exists yet for that activity
